subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear Passenger, We would like to inform you that there have been some changes to your upcoming flight schedule. Your flight departure time has been adjusted to accommodate unforeseen circumstances. Please review the new details below: Flight Number: AB1234 Departure Date: 15th September 2022 Departure Time: 10:30 AM We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. Safe travels! Best regards, Airline Customer Service
